title: hirtella indecora
intro: Hirtella indecora, commonly known as the "False Balsa" or "Koko tree," is a plant species belonging to the family Chrysobalanaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, providing relief from various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
